title: cerastium quaternellum subsp. octandrum
intro: Cerastium quaternellum subsp. octandrum, commonly known as a species of flowering plant, is a sub-species of Cerastium quaternellum within the family Caryophyllaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving digestion. The therapeutic actions of Cerastium quaternellum subsp. octandrum include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties, which help to soothe and protect the skin. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
